##### Project general facts

Wadi 645 is a boutique residential development. Designed around a “less is more” philosophy, the project introduces a new approach to urban living focused on minimalism, sustainability, and holistic well-being. Developed by JAD Global in collaboration with Greenside Developments, the project offers a curated selection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Set just 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai, Wadi 645 combines tranquil, nature-inspired living with seamless access to key city destinations, creating a balanced lifestyle for both residents and investors.

The amenities at Wadi 645 are thoughtfully integrated to function as natural extensions of the living spaces, reinforcing a sense of openness and community. Residents benefit from a rooftop infinity wellness pool with skyline views, a fully equipped gym, dedicated yoga and Pilates zones, co-working areas, and inviting social spaces. The project emphasizes both productivity and relaxation, offering outdoor gathering areas and a rooftop lounge that encourages interaction while maintaining a serene atmosphere. Every facility is designed with a minimalist aesthetic, ensuring a cohesive and calming environment throughout the building.

Interiors at Wadi 645 are defined by clean lines, open layouts, and a refined palette inspired by natural desert tones. Apartments are designed to maximize space, light, and functionality, with hidden storage solutions and minimal partitioning to create uncluttered living environments. Finishes include a blend of high-quality materials such as travertine, wood, glass, and metal, delivering a tactile and visually harmonious experience. Large windows enhance natural light flow, while advanced air and climate systems ensure comfort and efficiency. The result is a contemporary living space that prioritizes both aesthetic simplicity and everyday practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Majan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
